# GitHub Advanced Security (`GITHUB`)

<!-- Generated by `securefabric-cdk docs` from manifest.yaml, capabilities.json and mapping.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Code scanning, secret scanning and Dependabot alerts, with the repositories and branches they attach to, on github.com, GHE.com and GitHub Enterprise Server.

- **Version:** 1.0.0 (beta)
- **Auth:** `APP`, connected by redirect, vendor app required
- **Regions:** `github.com` (https://api.github.com), `ghe.com` (https://api.{subdomain}.ghe.com), `ghes` (https://{host}/api/v3)

## Permissions

| Permission | Access | Needed for | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Metadata` | read | `repositories`, `branches` | no |
| `Administration` | read | `repositories` | yes |
| `Code scanning alerts` | read | `code_scanning_alerts` | no |
| `Secret scanning alerts` | read | `secret_scanning_alerts` | no |
| `Dependabot alerts` | read | `dependabot_alerts` | no |
| `Code scanning alerts` | write | `finding.set_state` | yes |
| `Secret scanning alerts` | write | `finding.set_state` | yes |
| `Dependabot alerts` | write | `finding.set_state` | yes |

## Options

| Option | Values | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `secret_locations` | `first`, `all` | `first` | first: the first detected location only. all: every location (one extra request per alert with more locations). |
| `branch_scope` | `default`, `protected`, `all` | `default` | default: the default branch of each repository (no extra requests). protected and all list branches per repository. |
| `include_archived` | `boolean` | `True` | Include alerts on archived repositories |
| `secret_severity` | `unknown`, `critical`, `high`, `medium`, `low`, `by_validity` | `unknown` | GitHub assigns secret alerts no severity. unknown keeps it honest; by_validity derives it (active CRITICAL, unknown HIGH, inactive LOW) and lists severity in _meta.derived. |
| `listing_mode` | `auto`, `org`, `per_repo` | `auto` | auto picks organization listings for organization installations and per-repository listings otherwise. |

### Dependabot reachability

Dependabot reachability verdict (code-level reachability). "unavailable" (not computed yet) and "disabled" (analysis off) are absent from the table: the finding says null, never a guess (NORM-06).

| Vendor | Canonical |
|---|---|
| `reachable` | `REACHABLE` |
| `unreachable` | `UNREACHABLE` |
| `potentially_reachable` | `POTENTIALLY_REACHABLE` |

### Dependabot state

| Vendor | Canonical |
|---|---|
| `open` | `OPEN` |
| `fixed` | `CLOSED` |
| `dismissed` | `IGNORED` |
| `auto_dismissed` | `IGNORED` |

### Write back

| Group | Key | Value |
|---|---|---|
| `code_scanning` | `IGNORED` + `false_positive` | `{"dismissed_reason": "false positive", "state": "dismissed"}` |
| `code_scanning` | `IGNORED` + `accepted_risk` | `{"dismissed_reason": "won't fix", "state": "dismissed"}` |
| `code_scanning` | `IGNORED` + `test_code` | `{"dismissed_reason": "used in tests", "state": "dismissed"}` |
| `code_scanning` | `OPEN` + *(none)* | `{"state": "open"}` |
| `secret_scanning` | `IGNORED` + `false_positive` | `{"resolution": "false_positive", "state": "resolved"}` |
| `secret_scanning` | `IGNORED` + `accepted_risk` | `{"resolution": "wont_fix", "state": "resolved"}` |
| `secret_scanning` | `IGNORED` + `test_code` | `{"resolution": "used_in_tests", "state": "resolved"}` |
| `secret_scanning` | `CLOSED` + `revoked` | `{"resolution": "revoked", "state": "resolved"}` |
| `secret_scanning` | `OPEN` + *(none)* | `{"state": "open"}` |
| `dependabot` | `IGNORED` + `false_positive` | `{"dismissed_reason": "inaccurate", "state": "dismissed"}` |
| `dependabot` | `IGNORED` + `accepted_risk` | `{"dismissed_reason": "tolerable_risk", "state": "dismissed"}` |
| `dependabot` | `IGNORED` + `test_code` | `{"dismissed_reason": "not_used", "state": "dismissed"}` |
| `dependabot` | `OPEN` + *(none)* | `{"state": "open"}` |
